overview_description.description: Lofty is an expert-reviewed, online marketplace for valuable fine art, antiques and collectibles. Each Lofty item is reviewed and valued by Lofty's carefully selected network of experts, which includes qualified appraisers, current and former auction house specialists, reputable dealers, and other art world professionals with decades of experience evaluating items in their specialties. They believe buying art and antiques should come with complete peace of mind, and stand behind this commitment with a 5-year Authenticity Guarantee and a 100% Money Back Satisfaction Guarantee within seven days of delivery. Building sustainable, trusting relationships with clients is Lofty’s top priority.

about_short_description.short_description: Lofty is an expert-reviewed, online marketplace for valuable fine art, antiques and collectibles.

product.name: Lofty CRM
product.description: A customer relationship management system designed for real estate professionals to capture, track, manage, and nurture leads and contacts.

product.name: Lofty Real Estate Websites
product.description: Websites integrated with MLS IDX data to provide property listings and marketing tools for real estate professionals.

product.name: Lofty AI Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered virtual assistant that automates lead capture, qualification, appointment setting, and call screening for real estate professionals.

product.name: Lofty Lead Generation Marketing Services
product.description: Digital and direct mail marketing campaigns managed by Lofty to generate real estate leads through multiple advertising channels.

product.name: Lofty Social Studio
product.description: An automated social media marketing tool that generates and schedules posts from real estate listings, landing pages, and blogs.

product.name: Lofty Dynamic CMA (Comparative Market Analysis)
product.description: A tool that creates custom-branded, interactive market analysis reports to assist real estate agents in winning listings.
